name: INTEGRATED_ESDSA_V1
traceability_rule: POSITIVE and NEGATIVE classifications require a nonempty supporting excerpt found within the candidate answer after limited text normalisation. Any failed required excerpt forces DEFER.
stability_rule: The three generated variants must receive the same actionable pre-stability decision; otherwise defer the entire group.
important_limitations: Groups are assumed to represent alternative linguistic presentations, but semantic equivalence has not been independently established.
Literal excerpt matching does not establish that the excerpt proves the classification.
Three variants are not independent repeat evaluations of one unchanged interview answer.
Policy was specified after inspecting development results and must be tested on held-out cases.
This is not a deployable automated hiring system.
